scope: Local application/browser adapters and synthetic Worker/MCP; no live calls or deployment

checks.name: App release build and three Worker dry builds
Packaged task skill, changed prose, whitespace and document validation

acceptance_evidence: Three independently encoded neutral v4 cases match C#/TypeScript set, clear/label replacement and partial-date hashes. Existing hashes, operation values and legacy default serialization remain unchanged.

Native planning preserves canonical task order, game fields, lifecycle and history while applying only requested date/category/project/section/label fields. Partial edits and explicit clears retain original receipts.
Invalid/archived/missing references, incompatible sections, empty/contradictory/mixed patches, duplicate IDs and stale revisions refuse acceptance.
Linked, pending, conflicted and unknown mappings remain untouched; no effect, completion or Habit score is enqueued. Daily/paused-Habit/completed-Todo placement retains kind/state.
Portable journals reject missing or contradictory planning snapshots and fabricated game effects.

Controller receipt recovery retains one accepted plan after lost acknowledgement. Cloud previews reject changed targets/native fields/game fields or proposed effects; receipts reject contradictory projections.

Synthetic MCP advertises the narrow write tool, previews native placement on a linked task, reuses one original acceptance/receipt and preserves exported history/order/mappings. Write grants and tenant isolation hold; zero upstream writes occur.
limitations: The basic PWA editor has no placement controls. Organization CRUD and state/hierarchy/dependency authoring remain Pending.
Native planned date remains separate from deadline and game due state; the command cannot change game-facing fields.
Actual host/model activation, mobile behavior and live qualification remain unrun.
